# Goal

- Stop the file/sync routines from hitting the platform's 100-parallel-request limit when reading Linear threads; survive a rate-limit refusal

## Correct only if

- `mapBounded` runs at most `limit` calls at once and returns results in input order; unit test proves both
- `listCandidates` (linear-port.ts) and the thread reads in `entries/ux-chain-sync.ts` use it with limit 8; the 120-issue fake-port test asserts the bound
- `connectionGraphql` retries only a MembraneError with `error.data.key === 'rate_limit_exceeded'`, waits `error.data.data.retryAfterSeconds` (1 s when absent), at most 3 attempts, rethrows anything else unchanged; tests prove retry and give-up
- No new `any` / `unknown`; no reliance on narrowing after a throw guard (pre-receive type check)

- Finding nothing is a valid answer
